thesis: The podcast introduces Andrew Wagner, the author of The Economics of Online Gaming, who explains that he wrote the book after classmates at a college Christmas party suggested he document how he learned economics through playing the video game Railroad Tycoon 2. Wagner describes the book as a biography-style text that connects fundamental economic concepts like supply and demand and opportunity cost to gaming, aiming to make economics accessible and engaging for young people.
